tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild leukopenia and elevated hemoglobin, with otherwise normal red cell indices and platelet count. The markedly high platelet distribution width may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly reflecting platelet activation or turnover. Correlation with clinical context and repeat testing may be warranted to rule out underlying causes such as infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorders.
